

== Japanese original printing source ==
The ordinary Japanese printing is documented at [[Bespin Motors Void Spider THX 1138 (Japanese)]] with printing ID <code>1302_156o</code>. Left card in untouched 1224×830 composite only, including printed forfeit 4. Right missing-forfeit card is held separately; no ID or chronology assigned to it. Transcription uses the untouched embedded image from Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2, p. 48, SHA-256 <code style="white-space:normal;overflow-wrap:anywhere">e9ee705e8a3afb0c37fa744bc47aaf1ddace2762be4d0cf644e9967923400774</code>. The English reading aid is AI-produced and awaits independent review. <ref name="japanese-face">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 48.
